## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng treats the contemplative practice associated with Samantabhadra in the *Avataṃsaka* — the *guān xíng* 觀行 ("contemplation-practice") that constitutes the bodhisattva's specifically *Samantabhadra*-style cultivation. The work supplements *[Fǎzàng's Fā pútí xīn zhāng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0094)* (T1878) and other doctrinal works by providing focused treatment of contemplative methodology.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally datable to [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's mature period, c. 670 – 712 CE. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The work is one of the smaller items in Fǎzàng's substantial corpus, supplementing the major commentaries with focused contemplative-practice material.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X991) collection.
